questions.prompt: What are the Air Force Core Values?
choices: Integrity first; Service before self; Excellence in all we do.
questions.explanation: Air Force Core Values: Integrity first; Service before self; Excellence in all we do. Character, Connection, Commitment, and Courage are the Space Force's.

questions.prompt: What are the Space Force Core Values?
choices: Integrity first; Service before self; Excellence in all we do.
questions.explanation: Space Force Core Values: Character; Connection; Commitment; Courage.

questions.prompt: Complete the Honor Code: "We will not lie, steal, or cheat, ..."

and will report anyone who does.

questions.explanation: Honor Code: We will not lie, steal, or cheat, nor tolerate among us anyone who does.

questions.prompt: What is the Air Force Mission?

questions.explanation: Air Force Mission: To fly, fight, and win... Airpower anytime, anywhere.

questions.prompt: What is the United States Space Force (USSF) Mission?

questions.prompt: How many basic responses are there?
questions.explanation: There are seven basic responses: Yes, sir/ma'am. No, sir/ma'am. No excuse, sir/ma'am. Sir/ma'am, may I ask a question? Sir/ma'am, may I make a statement? Sir/ma'am, I do not know. Sir/ma'am, I do not understand.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the seven basic responses?
choices: Sir/ma'am, may I make a statement?
questions.explanation: "I will find out" isn't one of them. The seven are: Yes, sir/ma'am. No, sir/ma'am. No excuse, sir/ma'am. Sir/ma'am, may I ask a question? Sir/ma'am, may I make a statement? Sir/ma'am, I do not know. Sir/ma'am, I do not understand.

questions.prompt: An instructor asks a question you can't answer. Which basic response fits?
questions.explanation: "Sir/ma'am, I do not know." Use "I do not understand" when you don't understand the question itself.

questions.prompt: How do you excuse a flight or detail?
questions.explanation: "Sir/Ma'am, please pardon my flight/detail." (Basic Cadet Leader Knowledge, Block 1.)

questions.prompt: While in flight formation, who greets higher-ranking personnel?
choices: The first cadet to see them
questions.explanation: Only the Flight Commander greets higher-ranking personnel while the flight is in formation.
